profile.address: 580 Market Street, Ste 150, San Francisco, CA 94104
profile.summary: EDvance College is an independent nonprofit college in San Francisco for people who work in early childhood education. It offers a remote bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Studies, general education courses and a teacher permit certificate. Students are working educators, and the college partners with employers such as school districts. It is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission.

review.notes: EDvance College's own site and the WSCUC directory confirm a nonprofit, WSCUC-accredited early-childhood-educator college at 580 Market St, San Francisco, matching the agenda name, city and the early-educator funding source. Its Employer Partners page lists OUSD, and the summary, email, address and orgType are all supported and neutral.
